description:
Keep every session on court.

Zacks Court turns an iPhone on a tripod beside the court into a camera: it records at 1080p / 60 fps and analyses every shot on the phone in real time. You get hits, serves, ball speed estimates, bounce candidates and stroke types. A second iPhone, or a browser on any device, works as the display and shows each shot as it happens.

CAMERA
• Rear cameras with 0.5×–25× zoom, operated like the Camera app
• Finds the court from its white lines, or you can mark the four corners yourself
• Recordings and shot data are kept on the camera; it also works on its own, with no display
• When the phone gets hot or the battery is low, it trims preview and analysis load, never the recording frame rate or resolution

DISPLAY
• Speed, bounce and stroke at a glance, each opening full screen
• Courtside speed board: huge digits for the latest shot or serve, with serve max, average and trend
• Bounce map: estimated landing points on a top-down court; tap one to jump to that shot
• Line call estimates: in, out or "close to the line" after each bounce, with an optional spoken "Out"
• Start, pause and end sessions remotely, and mark highlights
• Pull a few seconds of video around any shot during a session; transfer the full recording afterwards

BROWSER DISPLAY
Any other phone, tablet or computer can scan the QR code on the camera to see live data, the speed board, a low-resolution preview and history in a browser. Nothing to install.

HISTORY AND EXPORT
• Browse by session, or filter shots by speed, bounce and stroke
• Share a single shot or save it to Photos (add-only; your library is never read)
• Storage page: clear old recordings while keeping every shot's data

NO ACCOUNT, NO CLOUD
Recordings and results stay on your own devices. Pair over the same Wi-Fi, a Personal Hotspot or peer-to-peer Wi-Fi; links between app displays are TLS-encrypted. The browser display uses plain HTTP on your local network and is less protected than the app display, so use the app or the camera's Personal Hotspot when that matters.

PLEASE NOTE
• Speeds, bounces, stroke types and in/out calls are single-camera model estimates, not radar readings or official line calls. When the evidence is missing, the value is shown as "—" with a reason, never counted as zero.
• The camera needs an iPhone 13 or later (including iPhone SE 3rd generation).
• No scoring.
promotionalText: An iPhone beside the court records and estimates each shot's speed, bounce and stroke live; another device or a browser follows along. No account, data stays local.
